text: {"text":"The proposed update would change the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. Over a twenty-four-hour benchmark, eighteen percent fewer origin requests were observed. That reduction is operationally promising, yet the evidence has a precise boundary: the benchmark did not measure the incidence of stale reads. Given both the positive result and that unmeasured outcome, I recommend approving only a canary deployment and requiring stale-read telemetry before any broader rollout. In short, the available evidence supports a limited experiment, but it does not support a broad rollout."}
